channel.title: Astrology guides | RasiVani
channel.description: Simple, practical guides to jathagam, porutham, panchangam and daily rasi palan, written for Indian families.

item.title: Vimshottari Dasha and Bhukti: Your Planetary Periods Explained
item.description: How Vimshottari dasha works: the 120-year cycle, mahadasha lengths for each planet, bhukti (antardasha) and how to find your current period.

item.title: 27 Nakshatras: Find Your Birth Star and What It Means
item.description: A simple guide to the 27 nakshatras (birth stars), their padas, ruling planets and how your birth star is used in naming, porutham and dasha.

item.title: Sade Sati (Ezharai Sani): Meaning, Phases and Simple Remedies
item.description: Sade Sati explained: the 7½-year Saturn transit, its three phases, Ashtama and Ardhashtama Shani, which rasis have it now, and calm practical remedies.

item.title: Rajju and Vedha Porutham: Why They Matter Most
item.description: What Rajju dosham and Vedha dosham mean in marriage matching, which stars fall in each rajju, and why families treat these two poruthams as essential.

item.title: Rahu Kalam, Yamagandam and Gulikai: How They Are Calculated
item.description: Why Rahu kalam changes every day and city, how it is worked out from sunrise and sunset, and what people avoid during Rahu kalam, Yamagandam and Gulikai.

item.title: Your Month Is Named After a Star: The 27 Nakshatras of Ancient India
item.description: Chaitra, Vaishakha, Kartika, Margashira... where do India's month names come from? The Moon's 27-star path, the full moon, the Pleiades, Karthigai Deepam and the number 108, in one short story.

item.title: How to Read Your Jathagam (Birth Chart): A Beginner’s Guide
item.description: Understand your jathagam step by step: lagna, rasi, nakshatra, the 12 houses, navamsa chart and dasha, with a free online jathagam in 10 languages.

item.title: 10 Poruthams for Marriage Explained (Thirumana Porutham)
item.description: All 10 marriage poruthams in plain words: Dina, Gana, Mahendra, Stree Deergha, Yoni, Rasi, Rasi Adhipati, Vasya, Rajju and Vedha, and how the score works.

item.title: What is Chandrashtamam? Meaning, days and what to avoid
item.description: Chandrashtamam explained simply: why the Moon in the 8th house from your rasi matters, how often it comes and what to avoid on those days.
